en-US.description: Play one complete Athan recording on an Echo. Fixed playback times can be set and changed in Alexa Routines.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my athan to play athan
en-US.name: My Athan

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Configure AUDIO_URL in lambda/index.js with a permanent direct HTTPS audio URL. Deploy and enable Development testing. Test launch, pause, resume, stop, and a full recording on an Echo. No audio recording is included.
